dedupe_keys.name: helios heating and cooling degree processing

description: helios is an R package for calculating population-weighted heating and cooling degree-hours or degree-days from weather or climate-model data. Its documented workflow processes raw fields, computes degree measures, checks diagnostics and exports results for models such as GCAM. Users set geography, population weights, climate product and period, so the package has no fixed national demand series. The public repository’s own licence has BSD-style two-clause terms with additional name and citation conditions, which are recorded as custom text, not a standard SPDX value. Degree measures can help estimate temperature-sensitive electricity or heat demand under changing climate. A caveat is that a weather index is only a driver of demand; buildings, prices and behaviour need separate modelling. No directly related catalogue record was established. The JOSS summary, own README, DESCRIPTION and licence were read without processing climate data. The resulting degree measures can supply temperature drivers to a building or electricity-demand simulation, but helios does not run that infrastructure model.
name: helios heating and cooling degree processing
notes: G5 G5-0726. Software checked through metadata and documentation, without installation or execution. Geographic scope follows the documented application or software portability; it does not imply validation throughout that area.
